title: Dominic and the Vector
author: Zephyrine Sandoval
blurb: Jude Lockridge, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
